::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 4th/1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 95-96
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Thanks for the copy of the [Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd) which is very prettily got up and attractive[^1] I never yet saw an illustrator who would avoid the height of the present fashion

I wonder whether you would think it worth while to publish a little book of stories of mine[^2] chiefly from Christmas numbers of the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) four being historical (one not hitherto published) - one modern life, as are also two others which have only been in American papers

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

Would it be too late to suggest to the illustrator of [Heartsease](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd)that in those days the Guards wore no moustaches?[^3]

I should have thanked you for [Spenser](other_books/otherbook_918.qmd) and [Burns](other_books/otherbook_919.qmd), I was sorry not

---

[^1]: This is a disparaging reference to the illustrations by [Kate Greenaway](people/person_2323.qmd) in the new collected edition.
[^2]: CMY is proposing the collection of stories republished as Bye-Words (1880).
[^3]: *Heartsease* was also illustrated by Greenaway.
